title: Rainforest - Vanilla Expanded
description: A mod that adds a vanilla friendly rainforest
body:
# Vanilla Expanded
Vanilla Expanded Rainforest is a part of the Vanilla Expanded Modpack. This mod focuses on creating a rainforest biome with additional blocks, mobs, and structures. The main goal of this mod, and the modpack as a whole, is to create a **vanilla friendly** overworld update in the style of an offical mojang update.
## Blocks
- Rainwood log
- Rainwood wood
- Stripped rainwood log
- Stripped rainwood wood
- Rainwood planks
- Rainwood stair
- Rainwood slab
- Rainwood door
- Rainwood trapdoor
- Rainwood pressure plate
- Rainwood button
## Mobs
- Red Panda
- Capybara
## Biome
- Rainforest
## Structures
- Llama pen
